pages.text: Julia is still cross. She will not look at Toby.
pages.picture: girl with arms folded, turned away from the dragon

pages.text: Then a big black dog runs up the path. Woof! Woof!
pages.picture: a big black dog charging up the garden path

pages.text: The dog barks at Toby. Toby gets cross. His spikes stick up.
pages.picture: the dog barking, the dragon's spikes bristling like a porcupine

pages.text: And then a bucket zooms up into the air. A rake zooms up. A pot zooms up, high, high, high!
pages.picture: a bucket, a rake and a flower pot shooting high into the sky

pages.text: Crash! Bang! Smash! They all come down. The dog runs off.
pages.picture: things crashing down, the dog running away

pages.text: Julia looks at Toby. Her chin drops.
"Whoa!" said Julia. "That is so, so cool! Do it on me! Make me float!"
pages.picture: the girl jumping up and down with excitement

pages.text: Toby looks down. "I can't," he said. "It is not up to me. When I am glad, not a thing floats."
Julia thinks hard. "Then we will fix it," she said. "I will teach you!"
pages.picture: the girl with a determined grin
